text:
Situation: Leucovorin calcium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 2.7 days of the 50 mg/5 mL injection, Corvale General holds 23.2 days, and Corvale Lakeside holds 24.5 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database, which began on 2012-01-01, shows no current listing for leucovorin calcium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Corvale East is at risk of stockout for the 50 mg/5 mL injection. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient supply to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks on hand.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 8 vials of 50 mg/5 mL, 5 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 26 vials of 50 mg/5 mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Transfer 12 vials of 350 mg/17.5 mL, 17.5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
4. Evaluate purchase from Epic Pharma LLC — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol substitutions; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
